text_block_list.text:
In a mock race shortly before the Shuka 
Sho, Daiwa Scarlet showed astonishing 
growth, driven by her refusal to lose to 
Vodka.

And... the day of the Shuka Sho had 
arrived, where the two grew and would 
clash once more.

Vodka steps up to face her, seeing a 
worthy opponent. Recognizing each other's 
strength, a serious clash between the two 
who have grown... begins now!
